name: After recital E
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: Ea. whereas the most recent ECB annual report criticised the high inflation of the past years, yet managed to avoid mentioning monetary inflation, i.e. the excessive increase in money supply compared to economic growth in goods and services during the past decade, at least once as a predominant reason for the inflation surge, despite the neutrality of money and the undisputable economic, mathematical and historical evidence for this causality in fiat-money systems;
